name: StrokeNet text-likeness of selected ink map
description: Chase Hendrick's StrokeNet (python -m kit strokenet) on the ink detection selected in VC3D, with its rotation and IAAFT controls. Needs a full-resolution 8-bit map; a score is model output, not a reading.

inputs.name: pixel_mm
inputs.label: Pixel size of the selected map in mm (0.0024 for a full-resolution 2.4 um map)
